summary: Notes that implementations handle well-known BGP communities inconsistently, which makes life hard for operators. It recommends that implementors not add further inconsistency going forward, and it updates RFC 1997. It asks operators to deploy consistent community handling while accounting for the differences that exist today.

eli5.summary: Different routers follow special tags on messages in different ways, which confuses the people running them. This tells makers to stop making it worse and to treat the tags alike.
